title: THE RADICALIZATION RISKS OF GPT-3 AND ADVANCED NEURAL LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot and few-shot prompting using questions, conspiracy theories (e.g., QAnon), and text snippets from radical groups to assess the model's ability to generate ideologically consistent extremist narratives and propaganda.

Using few-shot prompts derived from white supremacist mass shooter manifestos (e.g., El Paso, Christchurch) and neo-Nazi message board threads (Iron March) to generate racist, anti-immigrant, and white supremacist text.
Prompting the model with English and Russian-language neo-Nazi forum posts and toxic comments to test its ability to reproduce and expand upon anti-Semitic tropes, conspiracies, and hate speech.
